build_notes:
^xE05030FAQ^7

^x70FF70WE ARE USING CA, TS, OR LA TO CLEAR WITH^7
	-Manaforged to trigger Storm Rain for single target
	-No totem build

^x70FF70HOW ARE YOU GETTING 100 STORM RAIN?!!?!?^7
	-Dying Sun with 100% flask effect = 4 projectiles, should be 100% uptime with new sub-ascendancy
	-2 Proj on tree, potentially proj on bow/quiver if needed

^x70FF70HOW TO LEVEL?^7
	-Caustic Arrow + Toxic Rain (totems?)
	-Switch to Artillery Ballista or Storm Rain Manaforged once you get poison tincture, can also try out LA if you want over CA

^xE05030WHERE DO WE GET POISON WITH ELEMENTAL AS BOW?^7
	-New Tincture + New Sub-Ascendancy has "Poisonberry Tincture" which makes all elemental damage poison similar to pnemautic dagger from heist, but for bows
	-You still need to get 100% poison on hit
	-New Caustic Arrow transfigured has 40% chance to poison baseline, the rest comes from gear+tree+herald of agony if necessary

^x70FF70POISON CHANCE^7^7
	-You can get 70% from the skilltree, so we need to get 30% from other sources. Herald of Agony gives us 20%
	-2 jewels with 5% chance to poison each
	-Gloves with 10% chance to poison
	-Elder quiver with (up to) 20% chance to poison
	-Bow with (up to) 30% chance to poison

^x7070FFFLASK SET-UP IS IMPORTANT^7
	-Micro-distillery needs 5th flask empty, but tincture there should work as it replaces flask but isn't a flask
	-Because of belt we can only have one adjacent for the other ascendancy node, so we 60% flask effect on the dying sun from belt+adjacent node

^xAF6025STORM RAIN FORMULA^7
	-Number of Projectiles Fired
	-Bow Attack Speed
	-Projectile Secondary Duration
	-Size of your target
	-So the formula will be as follows: #of projectiles * attack rate * 1.6 * r
